description: Rijke dijk (Structuurvisie Eemsmond-Delfzijl) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Dit bestand bevat de "rijke dijk", zoals vastgesteld in de Structuurvisie Eemsmond-Delfzijl. Rijke Dijk is een samenwerkingsproject van Deltares, Rijkswaterstaat (o.a. WINN), TU Delft en Havenbedrijf Rotterdam en komt voort uit het landelijke Deltaprogramma. Het project Rijke Dijk draagt bij aan het verbeteren van de ecologie in het Eems-Dollard estuarium. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are dijken, downloadable-data, ecologie, flora-en-fauna, leefgebieden. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JPEG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-02-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
